0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-5) for the Magic's eighth game of the season. Orlando is 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 12th in the East, with a 0-4 home record, a 2-1 road record, and a two-game losing streak, while Phoenix is 3rd in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, and 12th in the West, on a four-game losing streak. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain, day-to-day). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Magic's most recent win coming 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
